QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_54

explanation.text: The Logic: Sharpe = (Portfolio Return − Risk-free Return) / Portfolio Standard Deviation. The Trap: Option 2 is Treynor (uses beta); others are wrong formulas. Cross-Exam Context: Identical formula in X-A, XV, IV. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Higher Sharpe = better risk-adjusted return; compare within the SAME strategy cohort.
